profile.reading:
Per NTT's own Global Data Centers facility page, this building, RagingWire CA3 (now branded NTT Sacramento CA3), is located at 1625 W. National Dr., Sacramento, CA 95834, the third of three buildings on NTT's Sacramento campus alongside CA1 and CA2. The operator publishes 64,723 square feet of data floor (technical) space and 14 megawatts of critical IT load for this specific building; no formal certifications or opening year are stated on this page. Combined, NTT's three Sacramento buildings total 52.7 megawatts of critical IT load campus-wide, per the operator's own campus overview page (a figure that reconciles cleanly with the three buildings' individually published MW figures, unlike the campus' square footage total, which does not cleanly reconcile with the sum of the three buildings' individually published square footage).

Sacramento's data center growth is drawing direct scrutiny from the Sacramento Municipal Utility District, which held a special board briefing in February 2026 on a surge of developer inquiries for large new electric loads in the region, naming NTT among the operators seeking service capacity; SMUD has said it is evaluating how to serve this demand without compromising reliability for existing residential and commercial customers.

NTT's US Global Data Centers footprint spans seven named campuses in total: Ashburn, Virginia at 224 megawatts; Chicago, Illinois at more than 200 megawatts; Dallas, Texas at 160 megawatts; Hillsboro, Oregon at 126 megawatts; Phoenix, Arizona at 240 megawatts; and a combined Sacramento/Santa Clara, California figure of 68 megawatts, totaling roughly 1,118 megawatts or more of disclosed US capacity, per the operator's own locations page. The US business operates under the NTT DATA Global Data Centers Americas name, the successor brand to RagingWire Data Centers, now under Japan's NTT DATA Group and parent Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation, a Tokyo Stock Exchange-listed company not subject to SEC 10-K filing requirements.

reading.body:
RagingWire CA3 is one building in a three-building Sacramento campus with a published total capacity of 52.7 MW across 266,000 square feet of data floor. The operator does not publish a per-building breakdown, so the campus capacity cannot be assigned to individual buildings. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 52.7 MW of IT load is roughly 1,300 racks. At 10 kW per accelerator, a conservative estimate for dense training hardware, the same power budget is roughly 5,300 accelerators.

California has published capacity of 365 MW across 11 mapped facilities with disclosed figures, making the Sacramento campus tied for 12th rank by published capacity. This campus ranks below dedicated hyperscaler infrastructure at larger US campuses but sits at the median of California's disclosed facilities. The state has 103 mapped data center facilities overall, and published specifications remain rare.

The operator's Sacramento campus holds Tier III or better certifications, which qualify it for mission-critical workloads including cloud and AI infrastructure. No published figure exists for power grid connection, PUE, renewable energy share, or any tenant commitment.
